description: Defines the gl::Buffer class and related classes for managing OpenGL buffer objects, including BufferState and Buffer classes, with methods for data management, binding, and state tracking.

classes.name: BufferState
classes.description: Tracks the state of a buffer object, including usage, size, access flags, mapping status, and binding counts.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL buffer object with methods for data management, binding, and observer notifications.

methods.name: bufferData
methods.description: Uploads data to the buffer object.

methods.name: bufferSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing.
